description: See the LATEST screen frame from a 'screen_share' action you created (pass the action_id from comms_action_create). Returns the current screenshot AS AN IMAGE you can look at, plus how old it is. The recipient must have opened the link and clicked 'share screen' first. Poll this every few seconds to watch live. VIEW ONLY — you cannot click or control their screen. Returns a 'no frame yet' note until they start sharing.

action_id.description: The action_id returned by comms_action_create for a 'screen_share' action you created.

name: comms_action_frame_get
